description: Sort and filter data in WPS Spreadsheet. Open /home/ga/Documents/customer_orders.xlsx which contains customer order data with columns: Order ID, Customer Name, Product, Quantity, Order Date, Ship Date, Status, Amount. Perform the following operations: (1) Sort data by Amount in descending order (largest first), (2) Apply autoFilter to all columns, (3) Filter to show only orders with Status='Completed', (4) Filter to show only orders with Amount greater than 100, (5) Freeze the first row (headers). Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
